dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hmm... Can't help feeling like this sword's not heavy enough. Feels too light when I swing it.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Guess Nod-Krai's forging styles just aren't to my taste. When I get back to Mondstadt, I'll have Wagner add some weight to this.

choices.text: I feel like I've heard that somewhere before...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Noelle? Hahaha, that checks out. She's not used to ordinary weapons either.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: I even thought I'd try to find some special ore here in Nod-Krai, bring a one-of-a-kind sword back as a gift.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Though... I've spent ages looking, and can't find the right stuff anywhere. Looks like I'm heading back empty-handed this time.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Anyway, I've heard that Noelle's learning Jean's Gale Blade. Heh, that lines up nicely. I'll teach her a trick or two when I head back.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: If only Noelle could wield dual swords like I do. That'd be perfect. Then I could show her how you can create a gale... with just your blade.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: She's still got a ways to go before she becomes a full-fledged knight, but for now... We can at least think up a proper knightly title for her!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Outrider... Lionfang Knight... What other Knights are we missing...

choices.text: I think Noelle also asked Wagner for help with something similar...
